title: Day
label: ch:ml-day
canDo: I can use divasam for an everyday day in Malayalam and still recognise native nāḷ where it survives.

payoff.summary: Count days with Sanskrit divasaṁ and set formal dinam beside it, then find nāḷ alive inside nāḷe, oru nāḷ and piṟannāḷ, and answer whether Sanskrit divasaṁ erased it.
payoff.note: ML-C23-naal is the chapter's last lesson and assesses all three atoms it introduces: divasaṁ and dinam (ML-C23-divasam) and the native nāḷ.
